name: CrowdStrike
tagline: Cloud-native endpoint and threat intelligence platform; one of the most reliable cybersecurity hirers in the industry
story: CrowdStrike runs the Falcon platform, used by a meaningful share of the Fortune 500 for endpoint detection and response, threat intelligence, and identity protection. They hire continuously across SOC analyst, threat researcher, detection engineer, cloud security engineer, and incident response roles. CrowdStrike University is their internal training pipeline for new hires, and the public-facing CrowdStrike Falcon Demo + CrowdStrike Adversary Universe content is the same material their analysts use day to day. Studying it before applying is the single best signal you can give in an interview.
why_hexworth: Eye house students (CySA+ track, threat hunting, forensics) and Shield house students (SOC analyst track, GRC, defensive security) align directly to their hiring profile. Code house DevSecOps tracks fit their detection engineering and platform engineering roles. Their public adversary intelligence reports also make excellent study material for the Eye house Threat Intelligence Analyst track.
what_they_value: Hands-on EDR / SIEM experience (Hexworth's Eye house Wireshark and SOC Operations labs map directly)
Adversary thinking — read their annual Global Threat Report before applying
Comfort with Linux command line and at least one scripting language (Python or PowerShell)
Communication: SOC analysts write clear, fast incident reports under pressure
cert_signal: CompTIA Security+ or CySA+ at minimum for SOC roles; OSCP signals deep interest for detection engineering
